    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve
) AS loss

answer.sql:
WITH claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount_Paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        string_agg(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN lower(apr.Party_Role_Code) IN ('policy holder', 'policyholder', 'insured')
                    THEN CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR)
            END,
            ', '
        ) AS Policy_Holder,
        string_agg(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN lower(apr.Party_Role_Code) IN ('agent', 'selling agent', 'producer')
                    THEN CAST(apr.Party_Identifier AS VARCHAR)
            END,
            ', '
        ) AS Selling_Agent
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role apr
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number,
    p.Policy_Number,
    pp.Policy_Holder,
    pp.Selling_Agent,
    COALESCE(prm.Premium_Amount_Paid, 0) AS Premium_Amount_Paid,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Loss_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Payment_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    COALESCE(cam.Expense_Reserve_Amount, 0) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount
FROM Claim c
LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts cam
    ON cam.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_to_settle
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
FROM Claim AS c
JOIN Claim_Amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Payment lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Reserve lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Payment ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Reserve er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT pa.Policy_Identifier), 0) AS average_policy_size
FROM Premium p
JOIN Policy_Amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

    p.Policy_Number,

        p.Policy_Number,
        cc.Claim_Identifier

    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM Loss_Reserve

    UNION ALL

    JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)

    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,

WITH premiums AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM Policy_Amount
    INNER JOIN Premium
        USING (Policy_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM Claim_Coverage AS cc
    INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date

losses AS (

    INNER JOIN Claim_Amount AS ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
    INNER JOIN Loss_Payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    COALESCE(l.total_loss, 0) / NULLIF(pr.total_premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy AS p
INNER JOIN Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN premiums AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses AS l
    ON l.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM Claim AS c
    LEFT JOIN Claim_Coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM Claim_Amount AS ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment AS ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve AS er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount AS pa
    INNER JOIN Premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        MAX(CASE WHEN apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICY_HOLDER' THEN apr.Party_Identifier END) AS policy_holder_identifier,
        MAX(CASE WHEN apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT' THEN apr.Party_Identifier END) AS agent_identifier
    FROM Agreement_Party_Role AS apr
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder_identifier,
    COALESCE(pra.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    pp.agent_identifier,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ca.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM claim_policy AS cp
LEFT JOIN Claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Catastrophe AS cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amounts AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_amounts AS pra
    ON pra.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties AS pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY cp.Company_Claim_Number, cp.Policy_Number;

WITH policy_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        c.Claim_Identifier

    LEFT JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

       AND cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
    LEFT JOIN Claim c
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    pc.Policy_Number,
    AVG(COALESCE(cl.loss, 0)) AS average_loss,
    COUNT(pc.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims
FROM policy_claims pc
LEFT JOIN claim_losses cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY pc.Policy_Identifier, pc.Policy_Number

WITH loss_by_claim AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                  OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
                THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_by_policy AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder,
    COALESCE(lbc.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(pbp.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid
FROM Claim c
INNER JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
INNER JOIN Policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'POLICYHOLDER'
LEFT JOIN loss_by_claim lbc
    ON lbc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_by_policy pbp
    ON pbp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier;

WITH loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM loss_amounts
    GROUP BY Claim_Identifier
),
policy_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM Policy p
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
       AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) AS premium,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_loss), 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_loss), 0) / NULLIF(pp.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_claims pc
    ON pc.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_losses cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    pp.premium
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;
